name: Catch of the day
source: Catch of the day follows Eric, a young guy working on a comercial fishing boat with his boss Louis. The two of them are having a fairly normal day, when something catches on their net - which turns out to be a merman.
translation: 当天的渔获讲述了埃里克（Eric）的故事，他是一个与老板路易斯一起在商业渔船上工作的年轻人。两人度过了相当正常的一天，这时有东西被他们的网捕获——原来是一条人鱼。
